description: History of sources of electricity generated in Québec is a dataset listed in Hydro-Québec open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. All of Hydro‑Québec’s historical data on the breakdown of the sources of electricity generated in Québec according to their real or estimated power in megawatts (MW). Coverage: Québec (Hydro-Québec). The portal files it under Infrastructure and grid. The portal shows 59,915 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-donnees-hydroquebec-com-portal.
